name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.165
notes: Medication Intelligence v165: retires the old medicine condition-rule engine from Log Medicine and Manage Medicines. Doctor Rule / Instructions remains as the user-entered clinician instruction field. Old conditionRules, legacy conditionMetric values, and MIP-approved formula thresholds are not evaluated, displayed as Doctor Rules, copied between medicines, or synced into medicine records.
label: MedicationConditionRulesRetired
summary: Removes the remaining old medication condition-rule path so Medication Intelligence is observational only: Doctor Rule, Today's Awareness, and Personal Pattern.
whatsNew: Log Medicine no longer runs old medicine condition rules, MIP threshold rules, pulse-pressure warnings, or HR formula warnings.
Manage Medicines no longer shows the old Condition Rules builder; users enter only Doctor Rule / Instructions.
Existing saved condition-rule data is cleaned from medicine records on load.
fixes: Removed the remaining condition-rule block/warn path from medicine logging.
Disabled old MIP-to-conditionRules migrations and sync helpers.
Updated Ask context/help wording so condition rules are not presented as active medication safety rules.
testing: Verified JavaScript syntax with node --check all.js.
